title: fix(plugin-approvals): an approval request record title reads the flow label (process_label), falling back to process_name
body:
Fixes #24007
Clause-②: no

The request's computed record title reads the flow's label in place of `flow:NAME`. No export, type, accept set or served column moves.

## What changed

- **`sys_approval_request.display_title`**, the object's `nameField`, is now `record.process_label != null ? record.process_label + ' · ' + record.record_id : record.process_name + ' · ' + record.record_id`.
  - A request opened by a flow labelled "Discount Sign-off" is titled `Discount Sign-off · opp_45`.
  - A row with no stored label keeps `flow:deal_desk · opp_42`, never `null · …`.
  - The guard is the idiom other platform objects already use (`sys-approval-action.object.ts`, `sys-automation-run.object.ts`, `sys-member.object.ts`).
- **The field comment** that said no null guard is needed now says why one is.
- **`titleFormat` keeps `'{process_name} · {record_id}'`** (see below). The comment above `nameField` says why, and names the renderer that reads it first.
- **`sys-approval-display-title.test.ts`**: the request case is now two pins, and the pairing is restated (below).
- **One `patch` changeset** for `@objectstack/plugin-approvals`.

No field description changed, so the translation bundles are not regenerated, and Acceptance 4 does not apply. `check:i18n` reading: see Gates.

## Premise, measured first (Acceptance 2's question)

On `origin/main` `b6805ac0f6`:
- `display_title` read `record.process_name + ' · ' + record.record_id`.
- `titleFormat` was `'{process_name} · {record_id}'`.
- `process_label` is `required: false`.

Can `process_label` still be null after the open write and the boot fill? **Yes.** Measured on a real `ObjectQL` over `SqlDriver` (better-sqlite3, in memory), with a throwaway probe that was not committed:

- **A failed fill run leaves every unfilled row null.** `backfillApprovalDisplayLabels` throws on a failed read. In the probe, a `find` that refuses gives `threw: "datasource refused"`, and the row stays `process_label: null`.
  - `approvals-plugin.ts` logs that at `warn` and retries on the next boot. Its own message says the cells "stay blank until a later boot fills them".
  - The fill also returns without running when the approval service is absent (`if (!svc) return`).
  - It runs on `kernel:ready`, so rows are readable before it finishes.
- **A row the chain cannot label stays null on every boot.** Take a request whose `process_name` humanizes to nothing (`flow:`) and whose config snapshot has no `__flowLabel`. The engine accepts that row: `required` refuses only `''`.
  - The first fill wrote 1 of the 2 seeded rows (`requestsFilled: 1`). The `flow:` row kept `process_label: null`.
  - A second fill wrote 0 rows.
- **The open write** stores `labelOrMachineName(flowLabel, processName) ?? null`. That is null only when `flow:` plus `flowName ?? nodeId` humanizes to nothing: `labelOrMachineName(undefined, 'flow:')` is `undefined`.

So `'{process_label} · {record_id}'` is not safe, and `titleFormat` keeps `{process_name}`.

## Which renderers read `titleFormat` first

- **The global search palette: `searchAll` in `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts`.** Its `renderTitle` tries `titleFormat` before `nameField`.
  - `sys_approval_request` is in its sweep. `canServeApiOperation(enable, 'search')` is true, and the auto-default search fields include `process_name` and `record_id`.
  - Measured through `searchAll` on this branch at `1afade209a`: a row labelled "Discount Sign-off" gets the palette title `flow:deal_desk · opp_45`. Its `nameField` value is `Discount Sign-off · opp_45`.
  - Measured on `main` with the template swapped to `{process_label}`: a row with no label gets the palette title `· opp_43`, with no source at all.
- **objectui's title readers rank `nameField` above `titleFormat`** (ADR-0079 order), read at objectui `daeb77f`. That covers `@object-ui/core` `getRecordDisplayName`, the record page H1 in `containers.tsx`, and `LookupField`.
  - So the record page's H1 and breadcrumb, and the Action History list's `request_id` cell, read `display_title`.

## The pairing, restated

`sys-approval-display-title.test.ts` held the formula and `titleFormat` to the same text. They now name different columns, so the file asserts:

- **With no label stored,** both draw `{process_name} · {record_id}`. This is the old assertion, kept, plus a check that `process_label` is null on the row.
- **With a label stored,** the formula draws `{process_label} · {record_id}`, and `resolveRecordTitle` agrees. `titleFormat` draws `{process_name} · {record_id}`.

## Tests

All runs went through `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`. Each verdict below is the lock's own `VERDICT command-exit` line.

- **The pin file at `1afade209a`:** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-approvals exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/sys-approval-display-title.test.ts` gives `Tests 6 passed (6)`, exit 0.
- **The whole package at the final head `ff2cf67c91`**, after merging `origin/main` `8133cc7805`, which brought #24064's `approval-service.ts` change into this package:
  - `vitest run --maxWorkers=2` gives `Test Files 81 passed (81)` and `Tests 1105 passed (1105)`.
  - Then `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-approvals run typecheck` runs `tsc --noEmit` on both configs, then `check:test-typecheck: OK`, with 27 pinned signatures held.
  - Exit 0 for the whole chain.
- **The same package run before the merge, at `1afade209a`:** 81 files and 1104 tests passed. Typecheck exit 0.

## Ablation (one-shot, nothing committed)

The test subject is imported by relative path (`./sys-approval-request.object.js`), so vitest reads `src/`. No `dist/` is involved, and no rebuild or dist preflight applies. Each leg went through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` in wrap mode, with a shell `trap` restore on top. Every restore was proven: the blob equals the HEAD blob `8ac394bf6ba2`, and `git diff HEAD` is empty.

- **Leg A: drop the label branch.** The formula goes back to `record.process_name + ' · ' + record.record_id`. Anchor 1 → 0, blob `8ac394bf6ba2` → `69cfd16dcea2`.
  - The authored-label pin goes red: `expected 'flow:deal_desk · opp_45' to be 'Discount Sign-off · opp_45'`, 1 failed and 5 passed.
- **Leg B: drop the null guard** (`record.process_label != null ? ` becomes `true ? `). Anchor 1 → 0, replacement 0 → 1, blob → `a5aee4f1c4ed`.
  - The null-fallback pin goes red: `expected null to be 'flow:deal_desk · opp_42'`, 1 failed and 5 passed.
  - The direction differs from the card's "not `null · …`" framing. CEL refuses `null + string`, so the unguarded formula yields a null title, not the text `null · …`. Either way the pin catches it.
- **A first leg-A attempt was a no-op.** Its replacement text already occurred inside the anchor, so `ablation-replace` refused it (replacement count 1 → 1) and restored, with no test run. It was redone with `--delete` on the label branch.

## Gates

**Local set.** `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` at the final head `ff2cf67c91` derives 65 commands. All 65 were run there, each exit captured before any pipe, and all 65 exited 0.

**Reconciliation.** `--ran` (each line records `:: exit N`) reports `65 derived, 65 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN`, and the zero is derived from the recorded codes.

**Verdict lines worth naming:**
- `check-i18n-bundles: OK (10 package(s) — all bundles in sync …)`, with `plugins/plugin-approvals in sync (7 bundle(s))`.
- `check-adr-0087-registration: this PR adds no declared-breaking changeset`.
- `No empty-frontmatter changeset introduced by this diff`.
- `check-nul-bytes: OK`.
- `check:type-check-debt … none above its recorded number`.
- `check:cross-package-test-inputs OK`.
- `check-test-source-alias OK`.

**A first union at `1afade209a` had two exit-3 results.** `check:i18n` and `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` reported `PREREQUISITE NOT MET`, meaning nothing was measured. Both were measured green in the final union, after the prerequisite build.

**Not run locally (CI's runs):** `test:repo`, the type-check lanes, the path-scheduled CI jobs and the roster families the derivation names. No exported symbol was renamed or removed, so `check-platform-checklist` was not owed.

`origin/main` moved to `8a83cebc15` after the merge. That is one TSDoc-only commit, in `packages/spec/src/contracts/http-server.ts`, touching nothing this PR reads, so it was not merged in.

## Acceptance notes

- **The palette still shows the machine source.** The global search palette ranks `titleFormat` above `nameField`, which the spec's own `titleFormat` description contradicts ("an explicit nameField now takes precedence", `packages/spec/src/data/object.zod.ts`). So on this branch the palette still titles a labelled request `flow:deal_desk · opp_45`. That is the renderer named above, and the cost of Acceptance 2's second arm. It is reported to the seat as a finding, not fixed here: `metadata-protocol` is outside this card's surface.
- **An underscore-only flow name stores `''` as `process_label`.** `prettifyMachineName` returns `''`, not `undefined`, for such a name (`flow:_`); `FlowSchema.name`'s pattern admits `_`. With an empty authored label, the open write stores `''`, which the new `!= null` guard reads as a label. Measured on the chain function only (`labelOrMachineName('', 'flow:_')` is `''`). No real producer names a flow that way. Carrier: none.
- **The changeset says "action history list".** The Action History list's `request_id` cell draws this title through the lookup's target `nameField`. That was read from the declaration, not measured on screen.
